```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

# 1. Load packages and functions

All functions live in `stock_functions.R`. `setup_packages()` installs any missing package and loads `quantmod`, `TTR`, `xts` and `zoo`.

```{r packages}
source("stock_functions.R")
setup_packages()
```

# 2. Portfolio

The symbols are read from `portfolio.txt` (one symbol per line).

```{r portfolio}
symbols <- read_portfolio("portfolio.txt")
symbols
```

# 3. Import stock data

`load_stock_data()` downloads one year of daily prices from Yahoo Finance for every symbol and stores each one as a separate data frame inside a named list.

```{r load}
stocks <- load_stock_data("portfolio.txt")
names(stocks)
str(stocks[[1]])
```

Each stock is also available as its own data frame, for example:

```{r separate-dfs}
AAPL_df <- stocks[["AAPL"]]
head(AAPL_df)
```

# 4. Display the imported data

```{r display}
display_all_stocks(stocks, n = 5)
```

## Latest quote (Yahoo Finance style)

```{r quotes}
for (sym in names(stocks)) display_quote(stocks[[sym]], sym)
```

# 5. Basic statistics

`calculate_all_statistics()` runs `calculate_statistics()` on each stock's **closing price** and returns the mean, median, mode (rounded to the nearest dollar), standard deviation, min, max, latest price and the 20- and 50-day simple moving averages.

```{r stats}
results <- calculate_all_statistics(stocks)
knitr::kable(results$summary, caption = "Summary statistics of closing prices (last 12 months)")
```

Moving-average columns added to each data frame:

```{r ma-preview}
tail(results$data[["AAPL"]][, c("Date", "Close", "SMA20", "SMA50")], 10)
```

# 6. Visualizations

## Closing price with moving averages

```{r line-plots, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
for (sym in names(results$data)) plot_stock(results$data[[sym]], sym)
```

## Candlestick chart (last 6 months)

```{r candles, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot_candles("AAPL")
```

## Comparing average price and volatility

```{r compare, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
s <- results$summary
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
barplot(s$Mean, names.arg = s$Symbol, main = "Mean Closing Price", col = "steelblue", las = 2)
barplot(s$SD,   names.arg = s$Symbol, main = "Standard Deviation",  col = "tomato",    las = 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

# 7. Notes

- Data source: Yahoo Finance through `quantmod::getSymbols()`. Prices are in USD.
- Results change each day because the date range is always the last 12 months.
- Mode is calculated on prices rounded to whole dollars, because exact prices rarely repeat.
